shortDescription: TEL AVIV, Israel, Sept. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Meitav Investment House (TASE:MTAV) today published its selected monthly business data for August 2026. children: ) today published its selected monthly business data for August 2026. The Company reports these data, which are material to its operations, under the monthly reporting mechanism announced in its immediate report dated March 2, 2026 (Reference No. 2026-01-019142). The mechanism was adopted to increase the transparency of Meitav's operations and improve the information available to investors.

These monthly data supplement, and do not replace, the Company's investor presentations, immediate reports, and periodic and quarterly reports issued in accordance with applicable law. The periodic and quarterly reports also include disclosure of these data.
Below are the selected business data1 as of August 31, 2026:
Meitav Provident & Pension Funds: NIS 251.5 billion
Total AUM: NIS 479.6 billion (approximately $161 billion)3, an increase of approximately 17.3% compared to total AUM as of December 31, 2025.
in the non–bank credit segment: NIS 4.15 billion (approximately $1.39 billion)3

) is Israel's largest investment house, managing financial assets of approximately NIS 479.6 billion for over 1.6 million clients as of August 2026. Established in 1979, the firm specializes in provident and pension funds, mutual funds, and tailored portfolio management, offering advanced, technology-driven financial solutions. In addition, Meitav has a large retail brokerage platform, institutional brokerage activity, credit activities and alternative asset management.
1 The selected business data are presented based on information currently available to the Company and are unaudited and unreviewed.
